claim_boundary: These are semantic screening decisions over retained evidence. They do not add dynamically validated strict comparators unless a separate validation ledger is cited.

decisions.title: Close all servers/ports after tests finish (#2741)
decisions.reason: The project-authored descendant commit is after the pinned source and touches testDemoProtocol, but its semantic change is an @AfterClass ProtocolUtils.closeAll teardown. It does not touch the within-test ExtensionLoader condition or encode the paper's injected-delay ordering. It is useful isolation-design evidence and a future backport candidate, not yet an exact repair comparator.

decisions.title: Fix ElasticJobExecutorServiceTest Flakiness (#2242)
decisions.reason: The commit is authored by Alisha-0321 and implements the same process-wide flag plus Thread.yield repair style. It is a FlakeSync-author artifact and cannot serve as an independent developer comparator.

decisions.title: Fix for issue #55: ThreadMonitor waits unnecessarily
decisions.reason: The independent project fix adds check-before-wait in ThreadMonitor and a focused regression test, but it predates the paper's pinned source by seven months and the exact check is already present at pinned lines 85-88. Therefore it is good synchronization-design context, not a later repair of FS055's recorded failure.

decisions.title: improve test reliability
decisions.reason: The project maintainer's descendant change replaces a probabilistic loss-ratio helper with explicit recovery/failure callbacks and exact event-count invariants. This is strong developer-design evidence, but it occurs 1,025 ancestry-path commits after the pinned source and changes production APIs; no transparent backport or matched adverse validation exists yet.
decisions.contrast_to_flakesync: The developer redesign observes domain recovery events and keeps bounded test completion; the generated repair uses a shared static counter and an unbounded yield wait.

decisions.title: Add more context to SpdyConnectionTest.receiveGoAwayHttp2 so that next flake is easier to identify.
decisions.reason: The descendant commit reaches the target only through its shared helper, retains the existing ping, and adds stream-state assertions to diagnose a future flake. It does not repair the recorded DeflaterSink ordering. Other synchronization candidates inspected for FS061 modify unrelated test methods.

strict_dynamic_comparator_count_unchange.note: All five decisions above are useful context or future validation candidates, but none currently satisfies the strict independent exact-behavior plus dynamic-validation rule.
